content_zh:
“1、2、3、4，2、2、3、4，3、2、3、4，4、2、3、4——别放松，换一边再来一组。”
跟着iPad里的英文，胡悦把哑铃换边，跟着教练一起继续做起左手的推举动作——王医生有句话是说对了，其实塞假体更多的是用到一种恰到好处的巧劲，也就是他说的瞬间爆发力。这次过来规培的两个男医生，有一个其实轮转的时候已经做过不少隆.胸术，平时自己也喜欢健身，所以塞假体一塞一个准，带上调整的功夫，最多也就是四五分钟。胡悦这几天没少在旁边观察，他用的的确就是腰腹和上臂的力量，使劲的时候肌肉隆起，一下就能把假体给送进腔隙里去。
耐力靠有氧，瞬间爆发力靠的就是无氧锻炼的肌肉力量，而和耐力比，其实肌肉还比较好养了。她也不是想要练成肌肉女，只要加强核心力量，不至于塞假体如生小孩，不叫出来真的就连那点力量都没了。
毕竟是学医的，对人体还是有了解，胡悦说一周也不是张口就来，她其实很清楚自己的上限在哪里，之前读大学的时候也锻炼过，毕竟有些医学岗位还是需要一定的体力的，之所以之后渐渐放弃健身，理由也很简单：忙。
再加一个，穷。
穷就意味着没余钱去办健身卡，当然，忙也意味着她即使办了卡也很少有时间去，更很少有体力。同时穷也意味着她住的单间地方狭小，甚至没有钱去买健康沙拉。医学生对于肥胖陷阱的体会应该是比较深的，都知道什么食物吃了不好，但没办法，又忙又穷，只能闭着眼睛往下吞。
有多穷？十六院是没有实习生的，所以规培医应该是最穷的，做得是和住院医一样的活，每个月大概就是两三千规培补贴，全国只有深圳给规培医生开出了十万一年的规培补贴——所以虽然深圳没有太多好医院，但真有规培医生冲着这个去的。否则，真是连规培都规培不起，按上海的物价，两三千大约也就是吃个饭买点水果，至于租房怎么解决，这个医院是不会管你的了。
住院医要好一点，尤其她进了个好科室，十六院的整形美容中心富得流油，上头的大佬赚得盆满钵满，也会漏点给下头的小虾米，基本工资也就是两千多，但算上补贴、奖金什么的，一个月七八千甚至上万，算下来是有的，不过大部分工资也都要贡献给房租：做医生就没有喜欢离医院太远的，他们这种小医生尤其是这样。住院总那一年就不说了，24小时都不能离开病区，住院医平时也少不了值夜班，至于加班……呵呵，那还是事吗？
做了医生，医院就是半个家，这点觉悟都没有，直接改行就好了。不过老牌大医院一般都在市中心，附近的租房不但年代老，而且也非常紧俏，价格绝对低不了，甚至很多房东专做短租，就是瞄准了医疗市场的生意。随便一个单间都是三四千的节奏，想要租个一室一厅，呵呵，怕不是要八、九千噢。
老公房，也别想着卫生条件能有多好，一些小昆虫，就算自己家里卫生维持得不错，一样会从隔壁爬进来。胡悦有时候对冰箱都有点心理阴影，即使能克服吧，但她每天是7点半就要到医院，如果不连夜班，晚上7点能从医院出来也算是早的，十六院在市中心，周围也没个菜场，还要切切烧烧确实不怎么现实。扣掉房租，三四千的生活费，也就只够她吃碗馄饨，偶尔再加根香肠了。
读书读到26岁才进社会，胡悦也不好再向家里伸手要钱，她家庭条件的确一般，也给不了什么支持，胡悦从读研究生开始就基本自立了。这房子还是她用自己研究生时期带家教攒下的一点积蓄付的押金，买这个哑铃她都是慎重考虑过的，之前还想拿个什么农夫山泉大瓶装代替，后来还是算了，上网买了一对20元的铁哑铃了事，至于吃食上要摄入的高蛋白，她采取最经济的办法：买一大堆鸡蛋，每顿狂吞20几枚蛋白。
在这个无常的世界上，身体是少数不会辜负你的东西，虽然在医院也见过不少反例，不过和别的事情比，人体还是值得信任的，只要按时锻炼，科学饮食，两到三次训练，真的就会有所不同。这一周练下来，累是累，但胡悦精神还算不错——如果只要在每天十二小时的工作之余，再锻炼个四五十分钟，这种程度的努力就能搞定师霁的话，那倒好了。

content_en:
"1, 2, 3, 4, 2, 2, 3, 4, 3, 2, 3, 4, 4, 2, 3, 4 - don't relax, switch sides and do another set."
Following the English on the iPad, Hu Yue changed the side of the dumbbell and continued to press with her left hand along with the coach - Dr. Wang is right in saying that in fact, inserting the prosthesis is more about using just the right amount of skill, which is what he calls instant explosive power. One of the two male doctors who came here for training this time had actually done a lot of breast augmentation surgeries during his rotation. He also likes to exercise, so he inserts the prosthesis accurately and takes only four or five minutes to adjust it. Hu Yue has been observing from the side for the past few days. He is indeed using the strength of his waist, abdomen and upper arms. When he exerts force, his muscles bulge and he can send the prosthesis into the cavity in one go.
Endurance relies on aerobic exercise, while instantaneous explosive power relies on muscle strength from anaerobic exercise. Compared with endurance, muscles are actually relatively easy to maintain. She doesn't want to become a muscular woman. She just needs to strengthen her core strength so that she won't have to wear prosthetics like giving birth to a child. If she doesn't cry out, she will lose even that little strength.
After all, she is a medical student and has an understanding of the human body. Hu Yue said that she did not just open her mouth for a week. She actually knew where her upper limit was. She also exercised when she was in college. After all, some medical positions still require a certain amount of physical strength. The reason why she gradually gave up on fitness after that was very simple: busy.
Add one more, poor.
Being poor means that she has no money left to apply for a fitness card. Of course, being busy also means that even if she does apply for a fitness card, she will have little time to go and even less energy. At the same time, poverty also means that the single room she lives in is small and she doesn't even have money to buy healthy salads. Medical students should have a deep understanding of the obesity trap. They all know what foods are bad to eat, but they have no choice but to swallow them with their eyes closed because they are busy and poor.
How poor? There are no interns in the 16th hospital, so the regular training doctors are probably the poorest. They do the same work as the resident doctors, and the monthly training subsidy is about 2,000 to 3,000 yuan. Shenzhen is the only country in the country that provides a regular training subsidy of 100,000 per year to the regular training doctors - so although there are not many good hospitals in Shenzhen, there are really regular training doctors who go there for this purpose. Otherwise, you really can't even afford regular training. According to the prices in Shanghai, two or three thousand is about enough to buy a meal and some fruit. As for how to solve the problem of renting a house, this hospital will not care about you.
The resident doctor is better, especially since she got into a good department. The Plastic Surgery Center of the 16th Hospital is extremely rich. The big guys above make a lot of money, but they also leave some money for the little shrimps below. The basic salary is more than two thousand, but including subsidies and bonuses, it can be seven to eight thousand or even tens of thousands a month, which is enough, but most of the salary has to be contributed to the rent: doctors don’t like to be too far from the hospital, especially small doctors like them. Let’s not talk about the year of being a resident. You are not allowed to leave the ward 24 hours a day. Resident doctors also have to work night shifts. As for working overtime... Haha, is that still a thing?
After becoming a doctor, the hospital is half of my home. I don't have any awareness of this, so I can just change my career. However, large and established hospitals are generally located in the city center. The rental housing nearby is not only old, but also very in short supply. The prices are definitely not low. Many landlords even specialize in short-term rentals, targeting the medical market. Any single room costs 3,000 to 4,000 yuan. If you want to rent a one-bedroom apartment, I'm afraid it won't cost 8,000 to 9,000 yuan.
Don't think about how good the sanitary conditions are in your husband's room. Some small insects will crawl in from the next door, even if your home is well sanitary. Hu Yue sometimes has a psychological shadow about the refrigerator. Even if she can overcome it, she has to go to the hospital at 7:30 every day. If she does not work the night shift, it is early to come out of the hospital at 7 pm. The 16th Hospital is in the city center and there is no market around it, so she has to cut it.Burning is really not very realistic. After deducting the rent, the living expenses of three to four thousand are only enough for her to eat a bowl of wontons and occasionally add a sausage.
She didn't enter the society until she was 26 years old. Hu Yue couldn't ask for money from her family anymore. Her family conditions were really average and they couldn't give her much support. Hu Yue had basically been self-reliant since she was a graduate student. She paid a deposit for this house with the little savings she had saved as a tutor when she was a graduate student. She had carefully considered buying this dumbbell. Previously, she wanted to buy a large bottle of Nongfu Spring instead, but then she gave it up and bought a pair of 20 yuan iron dumbbells online. As for the high protein intake in her diet, she took the most economical method: buying a lot of eggs and devouring more than 20 egg whites at each meal.
In this unpredictable world, the body is one of the few things that will never let you down. Although we have seen many counterexamples in hospitals, compared with other things, the human body is still trustworthy. As long as you exercise on time, eat scientifically, and train two to three times, it will really make a difference. After this week of practice, he was tired, but Hu Yue was in good spirits - if he could defeat Shi Ji with this level of effort after twelve hours of work every day, and exercise for forty or fifty minutes, that would be great.
